text:
Maya (People Ops): Quick question — someone on my team got charged a $7 UberPool cancellation fee when their flight was delayed and they had to cancel the ride to the airport. They paid with a personal card. Are cancellation fees like this reimbursable?

James H.: Short answer: usually yes if the trip was business and the cancellation was unavoidable. Need proof and manager sign-off.

Connor (Finance): Agree. We treat small unavoidable fees as reimbursable under "Transportation - incidental fees" but must follow the doc attach + explanation flow.

Maya (People Ops): What exactly should the submitter upload? Uber shows a little "cancellation fee" line but not always a full receipt.

James H.: Upload the Uber trip receipt screenshot (the in-app trip details), a card statement showing the charge if available, and a 1-line reason in the expense comment: e.g., "Flight UA234 delayed — missed connection, canceled ride; cancellation fee $7." Manager approval is required in the Concur/Expensify comment or as an approval email thread attached.

Maya (People Ops): Is there a dollar threshold where we need People Ops approval vs manager-only?

Connor (Finance): Standard thresholds: <= $25 manager sign-off is fine. > $25 requires People Ops review. If it looks like a recurring pattern (frequent cancellations by the same person), flag it for travel coaching.

Maya (People Ops): What if they had a company card but forgot to use it? Different handling?

James H.: If it occurred on a personal card but travel policy says company card should be used for airport transfers, treat the same — reimburse if reasonable and one-off. If they habitually use personal card instead of company card, manager should remind them of policy.

travel-bot: For reference: travel & expense policy — Rideshare and taxi: cancellation fees for business trips are reimbursable with receipt and approver note. See https://redwoodinference.com/policies/travel#rideshare (internal). :link: 

Maya (People Ops): Great, I’ll tell them to submit the Uber receipt + card screenshot and get their manager to add an approval comment. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:

James H.: If the submitter hits any error in Concur (upload size/type), DM finance and we’ll accept an email thread + attachments and we’ll attach on our end.

Connor (Finance): Also remind them to code expense as: "Transportation > Rideshare - cancellation fee" and mention the trip/purpose in the description. That helps accounting reconcile.

Maya (People Ops): Perfect — closing this thread.
